rect.data-content:
1A Context OS
ICP, personas, signal matrix, messaging, facts.md

1B Buying signals
• Named by a rival rewarded network
• UA event speaker
• Hiring UA roles
• New Tier-1 market launch
• Publisher ships new title
• New UA leader

1D Find companies
Game or studio name to domain

1F Enrich
Genre, live titles, markets, region, IAP, headcount

2B S1 Rival rewarded users
Freecash, long-window angle

2E Find people
UA Manager first, then CEO or COO, then Marketing Director

2G Write the sequence
Workflow spec and copy from facts.md only

3A Send the sequence
3 emails plus 2 LinkedIn tasks

3C Pipeline
• Meeting held
• Test campaign live
• Scaling or lost

3D Weekly review
Replies and meetings by signal, segment and persona
Weekly loop: results update the Context OS
